criteria.text: Package capacity is 20-person (or explicitly sufficient for 20) per catering.search.
If booking, the selected window's end time is ≤ 11:30 AM Saturday.
Does not treat window start time alone as proof of on-time arrival.
If only windows ending after 11:30 AM are considered/available, does not book; explains the timing conflict.
Delivery address referenced is 88 Market Hall, Bay City when a booking is made.
